quote_text: We don't have any formal process of like a code review, sitting down and talking about security risks
I usually don't as a developer go to the extreme of testing vulnerability in my feature, that's someone else's to do.
If they find a security issue, then you will be in trouble.
I would hesitate to release anything that's not functional and I also hesitate to release anything that had security concerns.
I would not feel comfortable with basically having something used by end users that I didn't feel was secure
